projectDescription: Enterprise AI platform that provides a centralized MCP registry, LLM gateway, Kubernetes-native MCP orchestrator, AI agent builder, security guardrails, and observability — enabling organizations to govern and scale AI adoption across all teams.
keyFeatures: Private MCP Registry with governance — curated catalog of approved MCP servers shared org-wide
Kubernetes-native MCP Orchestrator — runs MCP servers as isolated pods with lifecycle and credential management
MCP Gateway — single governed endpoint for all MCP tools consumed by Claude, Cursor, Open WebUI, custom agents
LLM Proxy — drop-in security proxy between AI apps and LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)
AI Tool Guardrails — deterministic context-aware tool call and tool result policies that survive prompt injection
Dual LLM security model — quarantines untrusted tool output in an isolated sub-agent to prevent prompt injection leakage
Built-in RAG Knowledge Base — chunking, embedding, hybrid search, and reranking without an external vector database
Cost monitoring and limits — per-org/team/user/agent spending caps and dynamic model optimization (up to 96% cost reduction)
Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing — per-agent, per-team token usage, tool call spans, and Grafana dashboards
SSO and access control — OIDC/SAML identity providers, role mapping, team sync, and SCIM provisioning
Terraform and Crossplane providers — infrastructure-as-code management of MCP registry and agents
ChatOps integrations — invoke agents from Slack, Microsoft Teams, or incoming email
publicApiSurface: POST /v1/mcp/{gatewayId} — MCP Gateway endpoint (StreamableHTTP or SSE)
GET|POST /v1/chat/completions — OpenAI-compatible LLM Proxy chat completions
X-Archestra-Agent-Id custom header for LLM Proxy agent attribution
